compliance_checklist.description: Scope of the application: the proposal must correspond, wholly or in part, to the topic description against which it was submitted; a partly out-of-scope application must be reflected in the scoring.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions — Scope of the application

compliance_checklist.description: Assessment of lump sum cost estimations: for lump sum topics, the evaluator (IER/CR) assesses the cost estimations and records approval of the lump sum budget or recommendations to modify it.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions — Assessment of lump sum cost estimations

compliance_checklist.description: Exceptional funding: a third-country participant or international organisation not listed in the General Annex may exceptionally receive funding only where participation is essential for the project; such participants and requested amounts must be justified.
Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC): the proposal must declare whether it involves hESC and, if so, whether such use is necessary to achieve the scientific objectives.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions — Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC)

compliance_checklist.description: Use of human embryos: the proposal must declare whether it involves the use of human embryos and, if so, explain how they will be used.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions — Use of human embryos

compliance_checklist.description: Activities excluded from funding: the proposal must not include human reproductive cloning, heritable genetic modification of humans, creation of human embryos solely for research or stem-cell procurement, or destruction of human embryos.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions — Activities excluded from funding

compliance_checklist.description: Exclusive focus on civil applications: the proposed activities must have an exclusive focus on civil applications; activities for military use or purposes cannot be funded.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions — Exclusive focus on civil applications
